title: "Failed to publish: publisher's context is invalid" on Ctrl+C in ROS 2: sending a last stop message from rclpy and rclcpp, measured
excerpt: Why a stop message published after Ctrl+C fails in rclpy and silently vanishes in rclcpp, why on_shutdown callbacks do not help, and which fixes delivered every message: SignalHandlerOptions, a SIGTERM handler, wait_for_all_acked and pre-shutdown callbacks. Measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
